es.B: Les respondí: «La palabra {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} vino a mí:
es.R: Les dije: «{{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} me dio este mensaje:

sw.L: Nami nikawaambia, "Neno la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} likanijia, kusema:
sw.B: Nikawajibu, "Neno la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} likanijia:
sw.R: Nikawaambia, "{{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alinipa ujumbe huu:

ko.L: 그래서 내가 그들에게 말했다. "{{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 말씀이 나에게 임하여 말씀하셨소.
ko.B: 나는 그들에게 대답했다. "{{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 말씀이 나에게 임했소.
ko.R: 나는 그들에게 말했다. "{{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 나에게 이 말씀을 주셨소.

decisions.choice: the formula as in Jeremiah, inside Ezekiel's answer
decisions.reason: The formula keeps its wording at each level. The quotation opened here closes at the end of verse 24.

decisions.choice: "m'a été adressée" inside Ezekiel's answer, where the narrative formula elsewhere says "me fut adressée"; the quotation runs to the end of verse 24
decisions.reason: Ezekiel is speaking to the exiles, and spoken French uses the passé composé; the formula keeps its words otherwise.

source.text: אֱמֹ֣ר׀לְבֵ֣ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל כֹּֽה־אָמַר֮ אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִה֒ הִנְנִ֨י מְחַלֵּ֤ל אֶת־מִקְדָּשִׁי֙ גְּא֣וֹן עֻזְּכֶ֔ם מַחְמַ֥ד עֵֽינֵיכֶ֖ם וּמַחְמַ֣ל נַפְשְׁכֶ֑ם וּבְנֵיכֶ֧ם וּבְנֽוֹתֵיכֶ֛ם אֲשֶׁ֥ר עֲזַבְתֶּ֖ם בַּחֶ֥רֶב יִפֹּֽלוּ׃

records.literal_gloss: Say to [the] house of Israel, Thus says [the] Lord Yahweh: Behold, I [am] profaning my sanctuary, [the] pride of your strength, [the] delight of your eyes, and [the] desire of your soul; and your sons and your daughters whom you left behind by the sword will fall.

en.L: Say to the house of Israel, Thus says the Lord {{divine_name:GOD|Yahweh}}: See, I am about to profane {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} sanctuary, the pride of your strength, the delight of your eyes and the desire of your soul; and your sons and your daughters, whom you left behind, by the sword will fall.
en.B: Tell the house of Israel, The Lord {{divine_name:GOD|Yahweh}} says this: I am about to profane {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} sanctuary, the pride of your strength, the delight of your eyes and the desire of your heart. The sons and daughters you left behind will be cut down by the sword.
en.R: Tell the people of Israel, This is what the Lord {{divine_name:GOD|Yahweh}} says: I am going to let {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} temple be made unholy. You are proud of it and trust in its strength. You love to look at it, and you long for it. The sons and daughters you left behind in Jerusalem will be killed with the sword.

fr.L: Dis à la maison d’Israël : Ainsi parle le Seigneur {{divine_name:DIEU|Yahvé}} : Voici, je vais profaner {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} sanctuaire, l’orgueil de votre force, les délices de vos yeux et le désir de votre âme ; et vos fils et vos filles que vous avez laissés tomberont par l’épée.
fr.B: Dis à la maison d’Israël : Le Seigneur {{divine_name:DIEU|Yahvé}} dit ceci : Je vais profaner {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} sanctuaire, l’orgueil de votre force, les délices de vos yeux et le désir de votre cœur. Les fils et les filles que vous avez laissés là-bas tomberont par l’épée.
fr.R: Dis au peuple d’Israël : Voici ce que dit le Seigneur {{divine_name:DIEU|Yahvé}} : Je vais laisser {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} temple être profané. Vous en êtes fiers et vous comptez sur sa force. Vous aimez le regarder, et vous y tenez de tout votre cœur. Les fils et les filles que vous avez laissés à Jérusalem seront tués par l’épée.

es.L: Di a la casa de Israel: Así dice el Señor {{divine_name:DIOS|Yahvé}}: Mira, yo voy a profanar {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} santuario, el orgullo de {{plural_you:su fuerza|vuestra fuerza}}, el deleite de {{plural_you:sus ojos|vuestros ojos}} y el anhelo de {{plural_you:su alma|vuestra alma}}; y {{plural_you:sus hijos y sus hijas|vuestros hijos y vuestras hijas}}, a los que {{plural_you:dejaron|dejasteis}} atrás, caerán a espada.
es.B: Di a la casa de Israel: El Señor {{divine_name:DIOS|Yahvé}} dice esto: Voy a profanar {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} santuario, el orgullo de {{plural_you:su fuerza|vuestra fuerza}}, el deleite de {{plural_you:sus ojos|vuestros ojos}} y el anhelo de {{plural_you:su corazón|vuestro corazón}}. {{plural_you:Los hijos y las hijas que dejaron|Los hijos y las hijas que dejasteis}} atrás caerán a espada.
es.R: Di al pueblo de Israel: Esto es lo que dice el Señor {{divine_name:DIOS|Yahvé}}: Voy a dejar que {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} templo sea profanado. {{plural_you:Ustedes están orgullosos|Vosotros estáis orgullosos}} de él y {{plural_you:confían|confiáis}} en su fortaleza. {{plural_you:Les encanta|Os encanta}} mirarlo y lo {{plural_you:anhelan|anheláis}}. {{plural_you:Los hijos y las hijas que dejaron|Los hijos y las hijas que dejasteis}} en Jerusalén morirán a espada.

sw.L: Iambie nyumba ya Israeli, Bwana {{divine_name:MUNGU|Yahwe}} asema hivi: Tazama, ninakaribia kupatia unajisi patakatifu {{deity_pronoun:pangu|Pangu}}, kiburi cha nguvu zenu, furaha ya macho yenu na shauku ya nafsi yenu; na wana wenu na binti zenu, mliowaacha nyuma, wataanguka kwa upanga.
sw.B: Iambie nyumba ya Israeli, Hivi ndivyo Bwana {{divine_name:MUNGU|Yahwe}} asemavyo: Ninakaribia kupatia unajisi patakatifu {{deity_pronoun:pangu|Pangu}}, fahari ya nguvu zenu, furaha ya macho yenu na shauku ya mioyo yenu. Wana na binti mliowaacha nyuma watauawa kwa upanga.
sw.R: Waambie watu wa Israeli, Hili ndilo Bwana {{divine_name:MUNGU|Yahwe}} analosema: Nitaliacha hekalu {{deity_pronoun:langu|Langu}} lifanywe najisi. Mnajivunia hekalu hilo na kutegemea nguvu zake. Mnapenda kulitazama, na mnalitamani. Wana na binti mliowaacha nyuma huko Yerusalemu watauawa kwa upanga.

ko.L: 이스라엘 집에 말하여라. 주 {{divine_name:하나님|야훼}}께서 이와 같이 말씀하신다. 보라, 내가 내 성소, 곧 너희 힘의 자랑이요, 너희 눈의 기쁨이요, 너희 영혼이 사모하는 것을 더럽히려 한다. 그리고 너희가 남겨 둔 너희 아들들과 너희 딸들이 칼에 쓰러질 것이다.
ko.B: 이스라엘 집에 일러라. 주 {{divine_name:하나님|야훼}}께서 이렇게 말씀하신다. 내가 내 성소, 곧 너희가 자랑하는 힘이요, 너희 눈에 기쁨이요, 너희 마음이 사모하는 그곳을 더럽히려 한다. 너희가 남겨 두고 온 아들딸들은 칼에 쓰러질 것이다.
ko.R: 이스라엘 백성에게 전하여라. 주 {{divine_name:하나님|야훼}}께서 하시는 말씀이다. 나는 내 성전이 더럽혀지게 하겠다. 너희는 그 성전을 자랑하고 그 힘을 믿는다. 너희는 그 성전을 바라보기를 좋아하고 그것을 몹시 아낀다. 너희가 예루살렘에 남겨 두고 온 아들딸들은 칼에 맞아 죽을 것이다.

decisions.choice: the delight of your eyes: the temple, as Ezekiel's wife was his
decisions.reason: The same words used for Ezekiel's wife (verse 16) are used here for the temple. As he lost what he loved most, so the exiles will lose the temple they were proud of and trusted. "The pride of your strength" is used in Leviticus 26:19 for what God will break.

decisions.choice: the sons and daughters you left behind: family members still in Jerusalem
decisions.reason: Ezekiel's hearers had been deported in 597 BC, and many had left children and relatives in Judah (2 Kings 24:14-16).

decisions.choice: the desire of your soul: what you long for
alternatives: what you pity, what you spare
decisions.reason: The noun is rare. It is usually related to a verb for sparing or feeling for something, and so means what one cherishes.

decisions.choice: I am going to let my temple be made unholy. You are proud of it ...
alternatives: I am about to profane my sanctuary, the pride of your strength ...
decisions.reason: Readable says what "profane" means and turns the three titles of the temple into short sentences. It adds "in Jerusalem" for where the children were left (m2).

source.text: וַעֲשִׂיתֶ֖ם כַּאֲשֶׁ֣ר עָשִׂ֑יתִי עַל־שָׂפָם֙ לֹ֣א תַעְט֔וּ וְלֶ֥חֶם אֲנָשִׁ֖ים לֹ֥א תֹאכֵֽלוּ׃

records.literal_gloss: And you will do as I have done; over [the] mustache you will not cover, and [the] bread of men you will not eat.

en.L: And you will do just as I have done: [your] upper lip you will not cover, and the bread of men you will not eat.
en.B: Then you will do what I have done. You will not cover your upper lip or eat the bread that others bring to mourners.
en.R: Then you will do what I have done. You will not cover the lower part of your face to mourn or eat the food that friends bring to mourners.

fr.L: Et vous ferez comme j’ai fait : vous ne vous couvrirez pas la moustache, et vous ne mangerez pas le pain des hommes.
fr.B: Alors vous ferez ce que j’ai fait. Vous ne vous couvrirez pas le bas du visage et vous ne mangerez pas le pain que les autres apportent à ceux qui sont en deuil.
fr.R: Alors vous ferez ce que j’ai fait. Vous ne vous couvrirez pas le bas du visage en signe de deuil, et vous ne mangerez pas la nourriture que les amis apportent aux gens en deuil.

es.L: Y {{plural_you:harán|haréis}} como yo he hecho: el labio superior no {{plural_you:se cubrirán|os cubriréis}}, y el pan de los hombres no {{plural_you:comerán|comeréis}}.
es.B: Entonces {{plural_you:harán|haréis}} lo que yo he hecho. No {{plural_you:se cubrirán|os cubriréis}} el labio superior ni {{plural_you:comerán|comeréis}} el pan que otros llevan a los que están de luto.
es.R: Entonces {{plural_you:harán|haréis}} lo que yo he hecho. No {{plural_you:se cubrirán|os cubriréis}} la parte de abajo de la cara en señal de luto ni {{plural_you:comerán|comeréis}} la comida que los amigos llevan a los que están de luto.

sw.L: Nanyi mtafanya kama nilivyofanya: hamtafunika mdomo [wenu] wa juu, wala hamtakula mkate wa watu.
sw.B: Ndipo mtafanya kama nilivyofanya. Hamtafunika mdomo wenu wa juu wala kula chakula ambacho wengine huwaletea wafiwa.
sw.R: Ndipo mtafanya kama nilivyofanya. Hamtafunika sehemu ya chini ya nyuso zenu kuomboleza, wala kula chakula ambacho rafiki huwaletea wafiwa.

ko.L: 그리고 너희는 내가 한 것과 같이 할 것이다. [너희] 윗입술을 가리지 않고 사람들의 빵을 먹지 않을 것이다.
ko.B: 그러면 너희도 내가 한 대로 할 것이다. 너희는 윗입술을 가리지 않고, 사람들이 애도하는 사람에게 가져오는 빵을 먹지 않을 것이다.
ko.R: 그러면 너희도 내가 한 대로 할 것이다. 너희는 애도하느라 얼굴 아래쪽을 가리지 않을 것이고, 친구들이 슬퍼하는 사람에게 가져다주는 음식도 먹지 않을 것이다.

decisions.choice: as I have done: Ezekiel speaks of himself
decisions.reason: Within the answer the speaker shifts from the LORD (verse 21) to Ezekiel, who points to what he did. Verse 24 returns to the LORD speaking of Ezekiel.

decisions.choice: not mourning: the loss will be too great, or come too suddenly, for mourning
alternatives: they will not be allowed to mourn
decisions.reason: The text does not say why the exiles will not mourn. They may be too stunned for the usual rites, or the disaster may be beyond the comfort of mourning. Verse 23 says that they will waste away in their sins.

source.text: וּפְאֵרֵכֶ֣ם עַל־רָאשֵׁיכֶ֗ם וְנַֽעֲלֵיכֶם֙ בְּרַגְלֵיכֶ֔ם לֹ֥א תִסְפְּד֖וּ וְלֹ֣א תִבְכּ֑וּ וּנְמַקֹּתֶם֙ בַּעֲוֺנֹ֣תֵיכֶ֔ם וּנְהַמְתֶּ֖ם אִ֥ישׁ אֶל־אָחִֽיו׃

records.literal_gloss: And your turbans [will be] on your heads, and your sandals on your feet; not will you lament and not will you weep; and you will waste away in your iniquities, and you will groan each to his brother.

en.L: And your turbans [will be] on your heads and your sandals on your feet; and you will not lament, and you will not weep; but you will waste away in your iniquities, and you will groan to one another.
en.B: Your turbans will stay on your heads and your sandals on your feet. There will be no mourning or weeping; instead you will waste away because of your guilt and groan to one another.
en.R: Your turbans will stay on your heads, and you will keep your sandals on. You will not mourn or cry. Instead you will waste away because of your sins and groan to one another.

fr.L: Et vos turbans [seront] sur vos têtes et vos sandales à vos pieds ; et vous ne vous lamenterez pas, et vous ne pleurerez pas ; mais vous dépérirez dans vos fautes, et vous gémirez l’un envers l’autre.
fr.B: Vos turbans resteront sur vos têtes et vos sandales à vos pieds. Vous ne prendrez pas le deuil et vous ne pleurerez pas ; vous dépérirez plutôt à cause de vos fautes et vous gémirez les uns avec les autres.
fr.R: Vos turbans resteront sur vos têtes, et vous garderez vos sandales. Vous ne prendrez pas le deuil et vous ne pleurerez pas. Au contraire, vous dépérirez à cause de vos péchés et vous gémirez les uns avec les autres.

es.L: Y {{plural_you:sus turbantes|vuestros turbantes}} [estarán] sobre {{plural_you:sus cabezas|vuestras cabezas}}, y {{plural_you:sus sandalias|vuestras sandalias}} en {{plural_you:sus pies|vuestros pies}}; no {{plural_you:harán|haréis}} lamento ni {{plural_you:llorarán|lloraréis}}, sino que {{plural_you:se consumirán|os consumiréis}} en {{plural_you:sus iniquidades|vuestras iniquidades}} y {{plural_you:gemirán|gemiréis}} unos con otros.
es.B: {{plural_you:Sus turbantes|Vuestros turbantes}} seguirán sobre {{plural_you:sus cabezas|vuestras cabezas}} y {{plural_you:sus sandalias|vuestras sandalias}} en {{plural_you:sus pies|vuestros pies}}. No habrá duelo ni llanto; en cambio, {{plural_you:se consumirán|os consumiréis}} por {{plural_you:su culpa|vuestra culpa}} y {{plural_you:gemirán|gemiréis}} unos con otros.
es.R: {{plural_you:Se dejarán|Os dejaréis}} los turbantes en la cabeza y las sandalias en los pies. No {{plural_you:harán|haréis}} duelo ni {{plural_you:llorarán|lloraréis}}. En cambio, {{plural_you:se consumirán|os consumiréis}} por {{plural_you:sus pecados|vuestros pecados}} y {{plural_you:gemirán|gemiréis}} unos con otros.

sw.L: Na vilemba vyenu [vitakuwa] vichwani mwenu na viatu vyenu miguuni mwenu; wala hamtaomboleza wala hamtalia; bali mtadhoofika katika maovu yenu, na kuugua kila mtu kwa ndugu yake.
sw.B: Vilemba vyenu vitabaki vichwani na viatu vyenu miguuni. Hakutakuwa na maombolezo wala kilio; badala yake mtadhoofika kwa sababu ya hatia yenu na kuugua ninyi kwa ninyi.
sw.R: Vilemba vyenu vitabaki vichwani, na mtaendelea kuvaa viatu vyenu. Hamtaomboleza wala kulia. Badala yake mtadhoofika kwa sababu ya dhambi zenu na kuugua ninyi kwa ninyi.

ko.L: 그리고 너희 두건은 너희 머리에, 너희 신은 너희 발에 [있을 것이다]. 너희는 슬피 울지 않고 울지도 않을 것이다. 그러나 너희는 너희 죄악 가운데 쇠약해지고, 서로 탄식할 것이다.
ko.B: 너희는 두건을 머리에 쓴 채로, 신을 발에 신은 채로 있을 것이다. 너희는 애도하지도 울지도 않을 것이다. 오히려 너희는 너희 죄 때문에 쇠약해지고 서로 탄식할 것이다.
ko.R: 너희는 두건을 머리에 쓰고 신도 신은 채로 있을 것이다. 너희는 애도하지도 울지도 않을 것이다. 오히려 너희는 너희 죄 때문에 점점 약해지고 서로 신음할 것이다.

decisions.choice: waste away in your iniquities: be consumed by guilt and its punishment
decisions.reason: The same words are used in 4:17 and 33:10, and in Leviticus 26:39 for the exiles in the lands of their enemies.

decisions.choice: groan each to his brother: groan to one another
decisions.reason: The Hebrew "each to his brother" means "to one another".

decisions.choice: iniquities (L); guilt (B); sins (R)
decisions.reason: The word follows the wording set for the prophets.

decisions.choice: iniquidades (L); culpa (B); pecados (R)
decisions.reason: 'Avon' covers both the wrong and the guilt it brings; each level uses the word that suits its register, as the English does.

source.text: וְהָיָ֨ה יְחֶזְקֵ֤אל לָכֶם֙ לְמוֹפֵ֔ת כְּכֹ֥ל אֲשֶׁר־עָשָׂ֖ה תַּעֲשׂ֑וּ בְּבֹאָ֕הּ וִֽידַעְתֶּ֕ם כִּ֥י אֲנִ֖י אֲדֹנָ֥י יְהוִֽה׃ס

records.literal_gloss: And will be Ezekiel to you a sign; according to all that he has done you will do; when it comes, and you will know that I [am the] Lord Yahweh.

en.L: And Ezekiel will become for you a sign; according to all that he has done you will do. When it comes, you will know that I [am] the Lord {{divine_name:GOD|Yahweh}}."
en.B: Ezekiel will be a sign for you; you will do just as he has done. When it comes, then you will know that I am the Lord {{divine_name:GOD|Yahweh}}."
en.R: Ezekiel will be a sign to you. You will do everything he has done. This will happen. Then you will know that I am the Lord {{divine_name:GOD|Yahweh}}."

fr.L: Et Ézéchiel sera pour vous un signe ; selon tout ce qu’il a fait, vous ferez. Quand cela arrivera, vous saurez que je [suis] le Seigneur {{divine_name:DIEU|Yahvé}}. »
fr.B: Ézéchiel sera pour vous un signe : vous ferez exactement ce qu’il a fait. Quand cela arrivera, alors vous saurez que je suis le Seigneur {{divine_name:DIEU|Yahvé}}. »
fr.R: Ézéchiel sera un signe pour vous. Vous ferez tout ce qu’il a fait. Cela va arriver. Alors vous saurez que je suis le Seigneur {{divine_name:DIEU|Yahvé}}. »

es.L: Y Ezequiel {{plural_you:les|os}} será por señal; conforme a todo lo que él ha hecho, {{plural_you:harán|haréis}}. Cuando esto venga, {{plural_you:sabrán|sabréis}} que yo [soy] el Señor {{divine_name:DIOS|Yahvé}}».
es.B: Ezequiel será una señal para {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}; {{plural_you:harán|haréis}} exactamente lo que él ha hecho. Cuando esto suceda, entonces {{plural_you:sabrán|sabréis}} que yo soy el Señor {{divine_name:DIOS|Yahvé}}».
es.R: Ezequiel será una señal para {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}. {{plural_you:Harán|Haréis}} todo lo que él ha hecho. Esto sucederá. Entonces {{plural_you:sabrán|sabréis}} que yo soy el Señor {{divine_name:DIOS|Yahvé}}».

sw.L: Na Ezekieli atakuwa ishara kwenu; kwa kadiri ya yote aliyoyafanya ninyi mtafanya. Litakapokuja, mtajua kwamba {{deity_pronoun:mimi|Mimi}} [ni] Bwana {{divine_name:MUNGU|Yahwe}}."
sw.B: Ezekieli atakuwa ishara kwenu; mtafanya kama yeye alivyofanya. Litakapokuja, ndipo mtajua kwamba {{deity_pronoun:mimi|Mimi}} ndimi Bwana {{divine_name:MUNGU|Yahwe}}."
sw.R: Ezekieli atakuwa ishara kwenu. Mtafanya kila kitu alichofanya. Jambo hili litatokea. Ndipo mtajua kwamba {{deity_pronoun:mimi|Mimi}} ni Bwana {{divine_name:MUNGU|Yahwe}}."

ko.L: 그리고 에스겔이 너희에게 표징이 될 것이니, 그가 행한 모든 것대로 너희가 행할 것이다. 그것이 올 때, 너희는 내가 주 {{divine_name:하나님|야훼}}인 줄 알 것이다."
ko.B: 에스겔이 너희에게 표징이 될 것이다. 너희도 그가 한 대로 할 것이다. 그 일이 닥칠 때, 너희는 내가 주 {{divine_name:하나님|야훼}}인 줄 알게 될 것이다."
ko.R: 에스겔이 너희에게 표징이 될 것이다. 너희도 그가 한 대로 모두 할 것이다. 이 일은 반드시 일어난다. 그때 너희는 내가 주 {{divine_name:하나님|야훼}}인 줄 알게 될 것이다."

decisions.choice: Ezekiel will be a sign: the prophet's life as a message
decisions.reason: This is one of only two places where the book names Ezekiel (1:3). The prophet himself is the sign, as in 12:6 and 11.

decisions.choice: you will know that I am the Lord GOD: the refrain
decisions.reason: See the note at 6:7. Here the knowing comes "when it comes": when the news of Jerusalem's fall arrives.

source.text: וְאַתָּ֣ה בֶן־אָדָ֔ם הֲל֗וֹא בְּי֨וֹם קַחְתִּ֤י מֵהֶם֙ אֶת־מָ֣עוּזָּ֔ם מְשׂ֖וֹשׂ תִּפְאַרְתָּ֑ם אֶת־מַחְמַ֤ד עֵֽינֵיהֶם֙ וְאֶת־מַשָּׂ֣א נַפְשָׁ֔ם בְּנֵיהֶ֖ם וּבְנוֹתֵיהֶֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: And you, son of man, will it not be on [the] day [when] I take from them their stronghold, [the] joy of their glory, [the] delight of their eyes, and [the] longing of their soul, their sons and their daughters,

en.L: And you, son of man, will it not be on the day when I take from them their stronghold, the joy of their glory, the delight of their eyes and the longing of their soul, their sons and their daughters,
en.B: As for you, son of man, on the day I take from them their stronghold, their joy and glory, the delight of their eyes and the desire of their hearts, and their sons and daughters as well,
en.R: Son of man, a day is coming when I will take away from them the temple, their strong place, their joy and pride. It is the delight of their eyes and the desire of their hearts. I will take their sons and daughters too.

fr.L: Et toi, fils d’homme, ne sera-ce pas au jour où je leur enlèverai leur forteresse, la joie de leur gloire, les délices de leurs yeux et le désir de leur âme, leurs fils et leurs filles,
fr.B: Quant à toi, fils d’homme, le jour où je leur enlèverai leur forteresse, leur joie et leur gloire, les délices de leurs yeux et le désir de leur cœur, ainsi que leurs fils et leurs filles,
fr.R: Fils d’homme, un jour vient où je leur enlèverai le temple, leur forteresse, leur joie et leur fierté. C’est ce qu’ils aiment regarder et ce qu’ils désirent de tout leur cœur. Je leur enlèverai aussi leurs fils et leurs filles.

es.L: Y tú, hijo de hombre, en el día en que yo les quite su fortaleza, el gozo de su gloria, el deleite de sus ojos y el anhelo de su alma, a sus hijos y a sus hijas,
es.B: En cuanto a ti, hijo de hombre, el día en que yo les quite su fortaleza, su gozo y su gloria, el deleite de sus ojos y el anhelo de su corazón, y también a sus hijos y a sus hijas,
es.R: Hijo de hombre, viene un día en que les quitaré el templo, su lugar fuerte, su alegría y su orgullo. Es el deleite de sus ojos y el anhelo de su corazón. También les quitaré a sus hijos y a sus hijas.

sw.L: Nawe, mwana wa binadamu, je, haitakuwa siku ile nitakapowaondolea ngome yao, furaha ya utukufu wao, furaha ya macho yao na shauku ya nafsi yao, wana wao na binti zao,
sw.B: Na wewe, mwana wa binadamu, siku ile nitakapowaondolea ngome yao, furaha yao na fahari yao, furaha ya macho yao na shauku ya mioyo yao, pamoja na wana wao na binti zao,
sw.R: Mwana wa binadamu, siku inakuja nitakapowaondolea hekalu, mahali pao imara, furaha yao na fahari yao. Ndilo furaha ya macho yao na shauku ya mioyo yao. Nitawachukua pia wana wao na binti zao.

ko.L: 그리고 너, 사람의 아들아, 내가 그들에게서 그들의 요새, 그들의 영광의 기쁨, 그들의 눈의 즐거움, 그들의 영혼이 그리워하는 것, 곧 그들의 아들들과 그들의 딸들을 빼앗는 날에 [그렇게 되지] 않겠느냐?
ko.B: 너 사람의 아들아, 내가 그들에게서 그들의 요새, 그들이 기뻐하고 자랑하는 것, 그들의 눈에 즐거움이요 그들의 마음이 사모하는 것, 그리고 그들의 아들딸들까지 빼앗는 날이 온다.
ko.R: 사람의 아들아, 내가 그들에게서 성전을 빼앗을 날이 온다. 성전은 그들의 든든한 곳이요, 그들의 기쁨과 자랑이다. 그들은 그것을 바라보기를 좋아하고 몹시 아낀다. 나는 그들의 아들딸들도 빼앗겠다.

decisions.choice: their stronghold, their joy, the delight of their eyes: the temple, as in verse 21
decisions.reason: The titles repeat those of verse 21. The temple was the people's refuge and pride.

decisions.choice: will it not be on the day ...: a question that runs on into verses 26-27
decisions.reason: The long sentence asks, in effect, "Is it not so that on that day ...?" and its answer is the promise of verses 26-27.

decisions.choice: the temple
decisions.reason: Readable names the stronghold as the temple (m1) and breaks the long question into statements.

source.text: בַּיּ֣וֹם הַה֔וּא יָב֥וֹא הַפָּלִ֖יט אֵלֶ֑יךָ לְהַשְׁמָע֖וּת אָזְנָֽיִם׃

records.literal_gloss: on the day the that will come the fugitive to you, to cause to hear [the] ears.

en.L: on that day a fugitive will come to you to make [you] hear [it] with [your] ears.
en.B: on that day a survivor will come to tell you the news.
en.R: On that day someone who has escaped will come and tell you the news.

fr.L: en ce jour-là un fugitif viendra vers toi pour [te] le faire entendre de [tes] oreilles.
fr.B: ce jour-là, un rescapé viendra t’annoncer la nouvelle.
fr.R: Ce jour-là, quelqu’un qui aura échappé à la mort viendra te raconter la nouvelle.

es.L: en aquel día vendrá a ti un fugitivo para hacer[te] oír [la noticia] con [tus] oídos.
es.B: ese día vendrá un sobreviviente a darte la noticia.
es.R: Ese día vendrá alguien que haya escapado y te dará la noticia.

sw.L: siku ile mkimbizi atakuja kwako ili kukusikiza [habari] kwa masikio [yako].
sw.B: siku ile mtu aliyenusurika atakuja kukuletea habari.
sw.R: Siku ile mtu aliyetoroka atakuja kukueleza habari.

ko.L: 그날에 도망한 자가 너에게 와서 [네] 귀에 [그것을] 듣게 할 것이다.
ko.B: 그날에 살아남은 사람이 너에게 와서 그 소식을 전할 것이다.
ko.R: 그날에 살아서 도망쳐 나온 사람이 너에게 와서 그 소식을 전해 줄 것이다.

decisions.choice: a fugitive will come: fulfilled in 33:21
decisions.reason: In 33:21, in the twelfth year of the exile, a man who had escaped from Jerusalem came to Ezekiel and said, "The city has been struck down".

decisions.choice: a survivor (B); someone who has escaped (R)
decisions.reason: The word means someone who escaped the disaster; Balanced and Readable put it in everyday words.

source.text: בַּיּ֣וֹם הַה֗וּא יִפָּ֤תַח פִּ֨יךָ֙ אֶת־הַפָּלִ֔יט וּתְדַבֵּ֕ר וְלֹ֥א תֵֽאָלֵ֖ם ע֑וֹד וְהָיִ֤יתָ לָהֶם֙ לְמוֹפֵ֔ת וְיָדְע֖וּ כִּֽי־אֲנִ֥י יְהוָֽה׃ס

records.literal_gloss: On the day the that will be opened your mouth with the fugitive, and you will speak and not be silent any longer; and you will be to them a sign, and they will know that I [am] Yahweh.

en.L: On that day your mouth will be opened with the fugitive, and you will speak and no longer be silent; and you will become a sign for them; and they will know that I [am] {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.B: On that day your mouth will be opened to the survivor; you will speak and no longer be silent. So you will become a sign for them. Then they will know that I am {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.R: On that day you will be able to speak again. You will talk with the one who escaped and will not be silent any longer. You will be a sign for them. Then they will know that I am {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.

fr.L: En ce jour-là ta bouche s’ouvrira avec le fugitif, et tu parleras et tu ne seras plus muet ; et tu seras pour eux un signe ; et ils sauront que je [suis] {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.
fr.B: Ce jour-là, ta bouche s’ouvrira devant le rescapé ; tu parleras et tu ne seras plus muet. Ainsi tu seras un signe pour eux. Alors ils sauront que je suis {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.
fr.R: Ce jour-là, tu pourras de nouveau parler. Tu parleras avec celui qui aura échappé, et tu ne resteras plus muet. Tu seras un signe pour eux. Alors ils sauront que je suis {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.

es.L: En aquel día se abrirá tu boca con el fugitivo, y hablarás y no estarás más en silencio; y les serás por señal; y sabrán que yo [soy] {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}.
es.B: Ese día se abrirá tu boca ante el sobreviviente; hablarás y ya no guardarás silencio. Así serás una señal para ellos. Entonces sabrán que yo soy {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}.
es.R: Ese día podrás volver a hablar. Hablarás con el que escapó y ya no guardarás silencio. Serás una señal para ellos. Entonces sabrán que yo soy {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}.

sw.L: Siku ile kinywa chako kitafunguliwa pamoja na yule mkimbizi, nawe utasema wala hutanyamaza tena; nawe utakuwa ishara kwao; nao watajua kwamba {{deity_pronoun:mimi|Mimi}} [ni] {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.B: Siku ile kinywa chako kitafunguliwa kwa yule aliyenusurika; utasema wala hutanyamaza tena. Hivyo utakuwa ishara kwao. Ndipo watajua kwamba {{deity_pronoun:mimi|Mimi}} ndimi {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.R: Siku ile utaweza kusema tena. Utazungumza na yule aliyetoroka, wala hutanyamaza tena. Utakuwa ishara kwao. Ndipo watajua kwamba {{deity_pronoun:mimi|Mimi}} ni {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.

ko.L: 그날에 네 입이 그 도망한 자와 함께 열려, 네가 말하고 더 이상 잠잠하지 않을 것이다. 그리고 네가 그들에게 표징이 될 것이고, 그들은 내가 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}인 줄 알 것이다.
ko.B: 그날에 네 입이 열려 그 살아남은 사람에게 말할 것이고, 더 이상 잠잠하지 않을 것이다. 이렇게 너는 그들에게 표징이 될 것이다. 그러면 그들은 내가 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}인 줄 알게 될 것이다.
ko.R: 그날에 너는 다시 말할 수 있게 될 것이다. 너는 도망쳐 나온 그 사람과 이야기하며 더 이상 잠잠하지 않을 것이다. 너는 그들에게 표징이 될 것이다. 그러면 그들은 내가 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}인 줄 알게 될 것이다.

decisions.choice: your mouth will be opened: the end of Ezekiel's silence
decisions.reason: In 3:26-27 God made Ezekiel unable to speak except when God gave him a word. In 33:22 his mouth was opened on the evening before the survivor arrived. The silence seems to have been a limit on his ordinary speech, not total silence, since he spoke many oracles in between.

decisions.choice: they will know that I am the LORD: the refrain
decisions.reason: The refrain (see 6:7) here closes the first half of the book: once Jerusalem has fallen, the exiles will know that Ezekiel's words were the LORD's.
